timecoded_text_to_speech.text: 2. Proface 2. It is a simple and short stage.
Chrom assumes again become shortened by contraction.
The centrioles migrate towards the pole and form spindle fibers.
Metaphase 2. The chromosomes now arrange themselves in a single row in the equatorial plane.
The centromia of each chromosome joins with the spindle fiber.
Anaphase 2. By the division of the centromia of the chromosome, two chromatids move apart from each other.
Thereafter it is known as a chromosome.
As a result, the second cell division occurs as in mitosis.
Due to the contraction of the spindle fibers, chromosomes shift towards the poles.
Telephase 2. After reaching to the poles, the chromosomes get covered by a new nuclear membrane
within which the formation of chromatin network starts.
At the end of the division of cytoplasm, two cells are formed.
At the end of meiosis, four cells are formed.
